title: Renaissance
notes:
Both album and titles stylized in all caps.

Explicit tracks: 1-4, 7, 9, 11-16.

Original version released July 29th, 2022; not to be mistaken with [r24119123].

Track 5, "Energy", contains an interpolation of "Milkshake", written by Pharrell Williams and Chad Hugo and performed by Kelis.

Track 11, "Heated", contains ableist lyrics ("Spazzin' on that ass / Spazz on that ass").
